# The Crunchy Heart — llms.txt

> The Crunchy Heart (thecrunchyheart.com) is a premium Indian Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand specializing in authentic Mithila Makhana (Fox Nuts / Gorgon Nuts / Euryale ferox), slow-roasted gourmet snacks, dry fruits, and spices. Sourced directly from Darbhanga wetlands in Bihar, India (Mithila GI Tag origin).

## Brand & Sourcing Lore
- **Brand**: The Crunchy Heart
- **Website**: https://thecrunchyheart.com
- **Product Focus**: 100% Satvik, zero palm oil, slow-roasted, export-grade popped lotus seeds (Makhana)
- **Origin**: Darbhanga wetlands, Bihar, India (GI Application #696)
- **Quality Grading**: Suta Grading standard (4 Suta micro to 7 Suta Jumbo Royal King)
- **Key Dietary Attributes**: Gluten-Free, Low Glycemic Index (~45), High Plant Protein (~9.7g/100g), Low Calorie (~350 kcal/100g), Rich in Calcium, Magnesium, and Iron. Vrat / Fasting friendly.

## Products & Core Offerings
- **Raw Makhana**: Export-grade 6+ Suta raw popped lotus seeds in 100g, 200g, 500g, and 1kg vacuum/nitrogen-flushed packs.
- **Flavoured Makhana (70g Packs)**:
  - Himalayan Pink Salt
  - Peri-Peri
  - Cream & Onion
  - Tangy Tomato
  - Chilli Garlic
  - Mint Pudina
  - Bihari Chat
  - Cheese & Herbs
- **Festive Gift Hampers**: Bespoke custom combo gift boxes (4 to 10 packs) and luxury celebration hampers.
- **Bulk & Wholesale (B2B)**: Wholesale supply from 100 kg to multi-tonne freight orders across 4, 5, 6, and 7 Suta grades with Certificate of Analysis (COA) and GST tax invoices.
- **Pantry Expansion**: Dry Fruits (Almonds, Cashews, Walnuts, Raisins) and Spices (Whole, Ground, Blends).

## Regulatory & Compliance
- **FSSAI License**: 10424000000001 (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
- **Manufacturing**: Roasted and packed under hygienic HACCP and GMP standards in Darbhanga, Bihar.
